item.title: SakuSaku Flakerie in Cleveland Park, “we’re no longer able to continue operating at this location, effective immediately.” - PoPville
item.description: 3417 Connecticut Ave, NW A lot of ups and downs at this space but SakuSaku Flakerie will for sure be missed here. Unclear if the Turkish place coming next door will be taking over this space too but we'll be sure to update when construction begins. You can see SakuSaku Flakerie's parting note: Stay tuned.

item.title: Do you believe in miracles?!? Bukom is opening back up!! - PoPville
item.description: 2442 18th Street, NW Last Monday a reader wrote: "Almost afraid to ask, but anyone know what’s up with Bukom Cafe in Adams Morgan? Hours have been sporadic for a while but I haven’t seen it open in days." Good news for Bukom fans!! Bukom Cafe is coming back!! Stay tuned for a reopening date.

item.title: Random Reader Rant and/or Revel - PoPville
item.description: photo by angela n. You can talk about whatever is on your mind – quality of life issues, a beautiful tree you spotted, scuttlebutt, or any random questions/thoughts you may have. But please no personal attacks and no need to correct people’s grammar. This is a place to vent and/or celebrate things about daily life
